is_anopheles.evidence: The vector species are Anopheles coluzzii (formerly An gambiae M form) and An. gambiae s.s. (S form) [9]. (Page 3)

reports_target_markers.evidence: The frequency of the 1014F kdr allele is 89%... (Page 3)

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper mentions a 1014F kdr frequency of 89% in the site description (Page 3), but does not provide the number of mosquitoes genotyped or any genotype counts (RR/RS/SS) for the mosquitoes collected during the study.

african_field_population.evidence: The Phase II experimental hut station is situated in a rice irrigation zone near Cove´ (7˚140 N, 2˚180 E), Benin. (Page 3)

is_primary_study.evidence: The efficacy of a novel mixture LN, Interceptor® G2... was evaluated under controlled household conditions (experimental hut trial) and by laboratory bioassay... (Page 1)

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The paper does not explicitly state the years in which the mosquito collections or trials took place.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The kdr frequency of 89% for the Cove site is likely a citation or re-report from Ngufor et al. 2015 (Ref 9), which is cited in the same paragraph.

supplement.evidence: S1 Table is described as 'Experimental hut data, excel file', which typically contains nightly collection counts per hut, not individual genotype data.

assessment.summary: The study evaluates the efficacy of Interceptor G2 nets against pyrethroid-resistant Anopheles gambiae s.l. in Benin using experimental huts and laboratory bioassays. While it mentions a kdr L1014F frequency of 89% in the site description, it does not report extractable genotype data (counts or frequencies with sample sizes) for the mosquitoes tested.
exclusion_reasons: No extractable genotype data (genotype counts or frequencies with sample sizes) are reported for the mosquitoes used in this study. The kdr frequency mentioned (89%) appears to be a site characterization, likely cited from a previous study (Ngufor et al. 2015).
